ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are four small square contour maps arranged side by side, labeled respectively as ①②③④. The forms of the contour lines in the four small maps are basically the same; they are all approximately parallel oblique lines, and the spacing between adjacent contour lines on the map can be regarded as the same. The question stem states that the contour-line values in each map all decrease from the upper left toward the lower right, and that the contour intervals of the four maps are all 50 m. Reasoning: slope = vertical height difference / actual horizontal distance. Since the contour intervals of the four maps are the same, the vertical height difference between adjacent contour lines is all 50 m; the spacing between adjacent contour lines on the map is also the same. The scales of the four maps are in order ①1:10 000, ②1:20 000, ③1:30 000, ④1:40 000. The larger the denominator of the scale, the larger the actual horizontal distance represented by the same map distance, and therefore the smaller the slope. Therefore the slopes from large to small are arranged according to the scale denominators from small to large.

raw_record.question_text:
The figure shows four contour-line distribution maps. If the values of the contour lines in the figure all decrease from the upper left toward the lower right.

<image1>

If the contour intervals of the four maps are all 50m, and the scales are respectively 1:10 000, 1:20 000, 1:30 000, and 1:40 000, then how should the slopes of the four maps be ordered from large to small?

method.method_draft: 先从图像读出四幅小图①②③④的等高线形态基本相同：都是方框内近似平行的斜向等高线，图上相邻等高线间距可视为相同；题干又说明高程数值均由左上向右下递减，且等高距均为50 m。再从文字读出四幅图比例尺依次为1:10 000、1:20 000、1:30 000、1:40 000。用坡度=垂直高差/实际水平距离判断：相邻等高线高差相同，图上距离相同，但比例尺分母越大，同样图上距离代表的实际水平距离越大，坡度越小。因此坡度按比例尺分母从小到大排列，即①>②>③>④。

推理：坡度=垂直高差/实际水平距离。由于四幅图等高距相同，相邻等高线的垂直高差都为50 m；图上相邻等高线间距也相同。四幅图比例尺依次为①1:10 000、②1:20 000、③1:30 000、④1:40 000。比例尺分母越大，同样的图上距离表示的实际水平距离越大，因此坡度越小。所以坡度由大到小按比例尺分母由小到大排列。

The question stem states that the contour-line values in each map all decrease from the upper left toward the lower right, and that the contour intervals of the four maps are all 50 m.
Reasoning: slope = vertical height difference / actual horizontal distance. The scales of the four maps are in order ①1:10 000, ②1:20 000, ③1:30 000, ④1:40 000. The larger the denominator of the scale, the larger the actual horizontal distance represented by the same map distance, and therefore the smaller the slope. Therefore the slopes from large to small are arranged according to the scale denominators from small to large.
